title: Nice machine; most versatile of the ones I've used, but still leaves watery coffee.
text:
Nice machine; most versatile of the ones I've used, but still leaves watery coffee.. After visiting a friend with a Keurig we caved and got one for ourselves. The coffee was convenient, and we've used plenty of Keurig machines in the past, so we had a substantial idea as to what we were getting. We chose this model as it seemed to cater both to individual cups and larger brews, and had a large water reservoir.

I spent about a good week messing around with all the different settings to finally land on the ideal settings for me--but it still isn't "perfect." As a Dunkin aficionado, I prefer black coffee with a bit of flavor swirls, and sometimes a bit of sugar depending on my mood. I found that, with this Keurig, it's best to make a smaller cup so I get that concentrated taste, and add flavored syrup and a bit of water to get it close to how I like. However, no matter what, the Keurig always leave the coffee watery, and that's not with the fact that I add just a smidge after the fact. I can never get that concentrated taste I like, and by the second cup I always toss the rest out after I finish half of it.

I also like to point out that Keurig doesn't make it easy to recycle these things. I knew of the environmental factor before purchasing, but as I had no reason to look up actual recycling services until after purchase I was shocked to find out they don't make it easy for consumers. I have to send it to third parties to get that done.

I do like the versatility and convenience. Visitors can easily make a cup of tea, hot chocolate, coffee, or cappucino in less than a minute. For that alone, Keurigs are well worth it. But as for everyday use I find it better to get some Dunkin from the local shop.

product_metadata.title: Keurig K475 Coffee Maker, Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Brewer, Programmable Brewer, Black
features: What's in the box: 6 k cup pods and a water filter handle and 2 filters to help your beverages taste their best

Large 70 ounce water reservoir: allows you to brew 8 plus cups more before having to refill, saving you time and simplifying your morning routine. The water reservoir is removable, making it easy to refill whenever you need to
K cup pod brew sizes: (4, 6, 8, 10, 12 ounce). Brews a carafe (22, 26, or 30 ounce) using k carafe pods, to give you more coffee when you need it. (carafe sold separately)
Strength control setting: allows you to brew a bolder cup using any k cup pod brew size. Plus, five temperature settings allow you to enjoy your favorite beverage at your desired temperature

Large color touch screen: with a digital clock makes it easy to brew a fresh, great tasting cup in under a minute. Plus, program your brewer to turn on or off automatically at set times, so that it is ready to go when you want it, and turns off to conserve energy
Auto on/off: program your brewer to turn on or off automatically at set times
description: A Premium and Customizable Single Serve Keurig Coffee Maker, the Keurig K475 brews a rich, smooth, and delicious cup every time with the quality you expect from Keurig. With a strength control setting for a bolder brew, five temperature settings, and multiple K-Cup, K-Mug, and K-Carafe pod brew sizes, you can customize your settings to get your perfect cup. Plus, an easy-to-use large color touch screen with a digital clock makes your brewing experience stress free, and you can even program your brewer to turn on or off automatically at set times. Whether you like your coffee strong, mild, decaf, or flavored, you can brew all of your favorites with the Keurig K475 – And with large 70oz water reservoir, you can brew 8+ cups before having to refill. Discover hundreds of K-Cup pod varieties from all of the brands you love, including Green Mountain Coffee, Starbucks, and Lipton, and enjoy coffee, tea, hot cocoa and more. Available in several colors to complement any décor, and also compatible with the Keurig Plus Series My K-Cup Reusable Coffee Filter, so you can brew your own ground coffee. Single Serve Coffee Makers are expertly engineered to deliver a consistently delicious beverage experience, giving you the same great taste, cup after cup. You can create and customize your perfect beverage, at the touch of a button, and prepare coffee, tea, cocoa and more just the way you like it. All Keurig brewers also dispense hot water, adding to their versatility. Refer instructional manual before use.
